cohort: 200 women who sustained an OASI during birth at the Royal Hospital for Women, Sydney between October 2009 and May 2014.
finding: More than half of the women who sustained an OASI experienced ongoing symptoms beyond the postpartum year, with significant impacts on their daily life and future birth choices.
mod_finding: Women who experienced a forceps birth were statistically more likely to experience ongoing negative outcomes after OASI (p = 0.03).
